subject: english
prompt: A school plans a global-project poster. Which topic best connects local action with a world issue?

options.text: Copying a foreign flag without any explanation.
Saving water at school and explaining why water matters in many regions.
Describing a single lunch without a question.

answer.explanation: The first topic connects a local action with a broader environmental concern.
